infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: APEX reads your workouts, sleep, HRV and weight from Apple Health to compute daily readiness and keep your training plan adaptive.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: APEX writes logged workouts and body weight back to Apple Health so every app you use stays in sync.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: APEX uses the camera to log meals and weekly progress photos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: APEX lets you pick meal and progress photos from your library.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Not used for photo capture, but required by the camera module.
